name: stimulus_structure_eval_v2_lite
description: Held-out controlled text stimuli for ASNE v2-lite event-structure evaluation. Labels are expected stimulus-response structure categories only.

items.text: A person watches a clerk arrange newspapers beside the front counter before the shop opens.
Someone stands near a museum bench and looks at sunlight crossing the tile floor.
A person reads the posted hours on a glass door and places a note in a folder.
A person turns when a maintenance cart comes closer from the far end of the corridor.
Someone sees a runner enter the alley and move toward the loading dock.
A person hears footsteps on the stairwell and sees another tenant come into view.
A person opens the case and finds the camera lens is not inside the foam slot.
Someone checks the mailbox and sees the expected parcel has not arrived.
A person reaches the rehearsal room and finds the violin stand empty.
A person reads the invitation address while the building directory shows a different floor.
Someone scans a barcode and sees a name that does not match the package tag.
A person checks two clocks in the hallway and sees each one showing a different hour.
A person searches the desk again and finds the signed form under a stack of folders.
Someone reloads the page and sees the missing reservation appear in the list.
A person returns to the lobby and sees the elevator doors opening after the repair crew leaves.
